scope: Fourteen explicitly named development-val rows in five photos; no additional photos or source-label files changed. Both008:19 and008:29 standard revisits authorized by the latest user text but retained.
method: Inspect original context and nearest-neighbor pixel crops alongside saved labels and fixed returned R26 predictions. Trace each own material rim/front-to-side turn; do not apply global brightness thresholds, midpoint rules, model-copy rules, neighbor clamps or mechanical shifts. Explicitly compare ymin as well when the user says ymax, and record any different-field correction. Preserve unchanged token strings, class, visibility and unavailable triplets.
axis_convention: Original image x increases rightward; y increases downward. ymin is upper box edge; ymax is lower box edge. Points denote the lower-front turns under this existing annotation convention.
